features.summary: Zed movement: run, jump with coyote time, jump buffer and variable-height jump cut. Arrow/WASD, Space/W/Up jump. Gravity set per body. Gamepad mapped to same key codes.
Fixed-step (60 fps) player state machine: idle, run, jump, attack, hitstun, block, dodge, parry. Attack buffer, chain cancel at cancelFrom, one swing id per move, onActive fires every active frame.

Player move table (frames at 60 fps): light1, light2, light3 (finisher, kick), heavy1. Light chain light1>light2>light3, heavy can follow light1/light2; light3 and heavy1 not cancelable. Damage/knockback/hitstun/hitbox come from combatData.js single source.

Defence: dodge (in-place sway, i-frames), block (hold, first frames are a parry window, 25% damage and knockback, no hitstun), dedicated parry (negates hits during window). Dodge/parry negate damage via guard field; block reduces. No HP refund or counter on parry.

Zed wrapper: Phaser arcade sprite, registers as 'player' (maxHp 100, hurtbox 32x72 centred), emits hit-request on every active frame with per-swing attackId, handles damage-applied (hitstun, knockback, red tint), dies on entity-died, respawns on retry.

Hit resolver: listens for hit-request, world-space AABB overlap vs registered opposing-team hurtboxes, dedupes per (attackId,target), applies damage via health component, emits damage-applied, player-health-changed, entity-died. Guard dodge/parry negate (amount 0 event), block x0.25 damage (min 1) and x0.25 knockback with 0 hitstun. Locks on round end, resets on retry.
Hit-stop: pure helpers (per-type ms, merged by max, capped). ArenaScene freezes attacker and target only (not timer or others) and adds camera shake and spark FX on hits >= 12 damage.

values.typeMapping: playerHurt if target is player; heavy if amount>=12; else light. 'finisher' and 'ko' keys defined but never selected

features.summary: Rust grunt AI state machine: idle > approach > telegraph > attack > recover; hitstun; dead. Depth-lane alignment, circling when attack slots full, knockback decay, telegraph progress for tint. Single enemy type only.

EnemyManager: spawns grunts, emits entity-registered (team 'rust'), forwards grunt hit requests as hit-request, applies hitstun/knockback on damage-applied, kills on entity-died, corpse lingers then entity-unregistered, destroyAll on retry.
WaveSpawner: 3 waves, per-wave start delay, spawn interval, maxAlive cap, round-robin spawn points; emits wave-started, wave-cleared, arena-cleared; removes on rust entity-died; restarts on retry.

Arena bounds and camera lock: while a wave is active the camera is locked at the wave's lockX and fighters are clamped to the screen with margin; unlocked after wave clear, follows player and eases (lerp 0.12). Lane clamp on y.
features.note: Zed y is fixed to GROUND_Y (LANE.maxY-40=640); player has no depth movement (jump only), enemies move in y.

features.summary: Arena failsafe: clamps enemies each frame; offscreen or stuck enemies repositioned to spawn points, removed after maxTeleports so the arena can always be cleared.
Round state: 120 s countdown, timer-tick once per second, round-lost 'timeout' at 0, round-lost 'ko' on player death, round-won 'cleared' on arena-cleared, retry resets (unlimited retries).

ArenaScene integration: wires resolver, round state, Zed, Arena, hit-stop, HUD launch, pause (Esc/P/blur/gamepad Start), end-of-round delay then ResultScene. ?sandbox URL param gives empty arena with no waves/timer. Only scene that runs gameplay; single level, no progression.

HUD: Zed health bar (360x28, turns red under 30%), wave label 'WAVE n / total', enemies-left count, MM:SS timer (red at <=10 s), wave banner ('FIGHT!' then 'WAVE n'), 'Esc: pause' hint that fades after 5 s.

ResultScene overlay: pause (Resume, Restart level, Main menu with confirm), win 'LEVEL CLEARED', lose 'KNOCKED OUT' / "TIME'S UP"; stats rows (waves cleared, enemies defeated, time remaining, health). Emits retry.

Title screen (graphics-drawn, loads copy json, blink and loading bar, fades to MenuScene) and Menu scene (FIGHT, CONTROLS, OPTIONS, QUIT strips; Fight starts ArenaScene; Quit only shows a toast). Keyboard and minimal gamepad.

Options: 12 settings across SOUND/PICTURE/THE FIGHT/EASY ON THE EYES, load/save localStorage key rebellion.options.v1, validation, apply/reset/dirty. Values placed in scene registry 'options' but nothing in gameplay reads them (screen shake, hit flash, timer visibility, volumes, text size all unconsumed). Only fullscreen is applied. No audio code exists in src.

Grunt, background and FX are SVG placeholders; grunt has single static image with tint, no frame animations.
